# GOV.UK Design System on the AI Platform portal

Authorities, in order: `ai-platform-frontend/.github/copilot-instructions.md` (design and content standards), the AICE `javascript-design-language` skill (Defra brand, layouts, `.defra-*` and `.app-*` classes), then the [GOV.UK Design System](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/) and [Service Manual](https://www.gov.uk/service-manual). Accessibility: `aip-accessibility`. Journeys: `aip-user-flows`.

## Rules that are easy to get wrong

| Area              | Do                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Don't                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Components        | Use the `govuk*` Nunjucks macros with their documented options                                                                                                                                            | Hand-write component HTML or override `.govuk-*` classes                                                                                                                   |
| Brand             | Defra header and footer, Helvetica or Arial, brand greens per the design-language skill                                                                                                                   | GOV.UK crown, GDS Transport font, "GOV.UK" in titles ([not on service.gov.uk](https://frontend.design-system.service.gov.uk/using-govuk-frontend-without-govuk-branding/)) |
| Page title        | `{Page heading} \| AI Platform Portal`; on error prefix `Error: `                                                                                                                                         | Same title on every page                                                                                                                                                   |
| Questions         | [One thing per page](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/patterns/question-pages/); the label or legend is the `h1`                                                                                      | Several unrelated questions on one page                                                                                                                                    |
| Validation        | [Error summary](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/error-summary/) at top linking to each field, inline error message, values kept, server-side Joi                                          | Client-only validation; generic "invalid input"                                                                                                                            |
| Buttons           | "Continue" on question pages; specific verbs elsewhere ("Request access"); one primary button                                                                                                             | "Submit"; several primary buttons                                                                                                                                          |
| Check and confirm | [Check answers](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/patterns/check-answers/) before a consequential action; [confirmation page](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/patterns/confirmation-pages/) after | Acting on the first POST without a review step                                                                                                                             |
| Navigation        | Back link on question pages; breadcrumbs only in hub sections                                                                                                                                             | Both on the same page                                                                                                                                                      |
| Content           | Plain English, sentence case, "people" not "users", "Defra" not "DEFRA", [GOV.UK A to Z](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/style-guide/a-to-z)                                                                  | Jargon, internal status names, ids or raw errors                                                                                                                           |
| Enhancement       | Works without JavaScript; JS only enhances (`src/client/javascripts/application.js`) ([progressive enhancement](https://www.gov.uk/service-manual/technology/using-progressive-enhancement))              | A journey step that needs JS                                                                                                                                               |
| Security          | CSRF crumb on every POST form; no inline scripts or styles (CSP)                                                                                                                                          | The `safe` filter on anything from a person or the API                                                                                                                     |

## Building a page

1. Name the user need and the pattern it follows (question, check answers, confirmation, hub, task list). Link it in `plan.md`.
2. Reuse a layout and macro from the design-language skill; new reusable UI goes in `src/server/common/components/<name>/` with a `template.test.js`.
3. Controller: validate, call `api-client.js`, map the API `code` to a human message, render. No business rules in the view.
4. Tests: controller (`server.inject`: GET renders, POST invalid shows the error summary and keeps values, POST valid redirects, CSRF required), component template tests, then the accessibility checks.

## Service Standard points this touches

[1 understand users](https://www.gov.uk/service-manual/service-standard/point-1-understand-user-needs), [2 whole problem](https://www.gov.uk/service-manual/service-standard/point-2-solve-a-whole-problem), [4 simple to use](https://www.gov.uk/service-manual/service-standard/point-4-make-the-service-simple-to-use), [5 everyone can use it](https://www.gov.uk/service-manual/service-standard/point-5-make-sure-everyone-can-use-the-service), [13 common components](https://www.gov.uk/service-manual/service-standard/point-13-use-common-standards-components-patterns).
